title: Show issue subtitle under the title on @kanbus/ui board cards
description:
Ryan wants board cards to show the title and, when set, the subtitle or blurb, using the real @kanbus/ui component (the Papyrus marketing site renders it). Work: - Add optional host-supplied `subtitle?: string` to `KanbanIssue` (packages/ui/src/kanban/types.ts). No CLI or schema change. - Render `

` under the card title only when non-empty; include it in the IssueCard memo comparator. - Default muted, modest styling in kanban.css. - Cucumber coverage in packages/ui: shown when set, absent when unset. - Remove leftover `console.log("[Board] ...")` debug lines in Board.tsx Flip code. - Patch/minor version bump of @kanbus/ui. Acceptance: a card with a subtitle shows it under the title; a card without one renders no empty subtitle element; packages/ui tests, typecheck and build pass.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Implemented on branch feature/kbs-2696c3-card-subtitle, commit c0f470b4, PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Kanbus/pull/533 (into develop, not merged).

Verification: packages/ui npm test 71 scenarios / 410 steps pass (new features/card_subtitle.feature; shown-subtitle scenarios fail on the old IssueCard). apps/console typecheck and build pass. Tarball kanbus-ui-0.4.2.tgz sha256 d736ba330ac6ae230cd15b1d534243e55e632b22654c93fbafde7524e1208a47.

The [Board] Flip console.log lines were already removed on develop in 098f2a99.
